name: Adventurer's Guild, Universal Trainer
desc1: This large square room is completely empty, save for a large, exotic-
desc2: looking contraption placed right in the centre of the floor. It
desc3: appears to be made of a flat black metal, and is crafted in the shape
desc4: of a featureless humanoid. You recognize it as a magical device used
desc5: to train people in their various abilities, and it uses its magical
desc6: powers to take any shape and to project illusions. This model is not
desc7: very advanced, however, and can only train the relatively unskilled.
